_doc: Candidate routes. Gateway side is identical for all: TDAI_LLM_BASE_URL -> loopback shim -> upstream. Prices USD per 1M tokens from live catalogs 2026-10-03 (scratch/vercel-models.json, openrouter-models.json). Keys are BWS secret NAMES only.

candidates.settings: provider defaults (gateway sends no temperature/reasoning) - identical to production
reasoning_effort=low injected by shim; otherwise provider defaults
candidates.why_not: Route blocked 2026-10-03: Vercel AI Gateway (BWS AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY, $4.9995 free-tier credit) answers 403 RestrictedModelsError 'Free tier users do not have access to this model' (probe runs/probes/grok-4.7-low/, $0 spent); OpenRouter key credit limit is $0; BWS OPENAI_API_KEY lacks model scope (403); no xAI API key. Subscription CLIs (grok CLI / codex) are not the gateway's OpenAI-protocol path. Unblock (owner action, no harness change): top up Vercel to paid credits, or raise the OpenRouter key limit to >= $5 and use alt_endpoint.

candidates.settings: reasoning_effort=xhigh injected by shim; otherwise provider defaults
candidates.why_not: Route blocked 2026-10-03: Vercel AI Gateway (BWS AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY, $4.9995 free-tier credit) answers 403 RestrictedModelsError 'Free tier users do not have access to this model' (probe runs/probes/luna-xhigh/, $0 spent); OpenRouter key credit limit is $0; BWS OPENAI_API_KEY lacks model scope (403); no xAI API key. Subscription CLIs (grok CLI / codex) are not the gateway's OpenAI-protocol path. Unblock (owner action, no harness change): top up Vercel to paid credits, or raise the OpenRouter key limit to >= $5 and use alt_endpoint.

No free/credentialed route: original api.x.ai path used an xAI OAuth access token that expired (no xAI API key in BWS); only route is paid Vercel AI Gateway, and the task rules allow paid spend only for the owner-named grok-4.7-low and luna-xhigh. Owner approval would make it callable (est. <$0.30 for the full L1 corpus x3).

candidates.why_not: Excluded a priori (pre-registered): below the 3B floor; 2026-09-20 evidence had qwen2.5:3b at 0% schema compliance on these prompts, and the L1 system prompt alone is ~6-7k Chinese tokens. Route works; can be added if any 3-4B arm passes the gates.
Excluded a priori (pre-registered): far below the 3B floor (see qwen3-1.7b).

candidates.settings: -c 8192 --parallel 2 (~4k tokens per slot), shared with mbp z0int
candidates.why_not: The shared router's ~4k-token slots are smaller than the L1 system prompt plus a window, so every call would truncate or 400; changing its -c affects z0int (not ours to change). The same GGUFs are benchmarked on a dedicated llama-server instead.
